audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 4-5 and Level 6 read Skill on both layers while the prose treats 6 as 'your cleanest kill window all game'; 2+ items read Riven while whys[6], spikes[3] and late all say the 1v1 edge is gone. Packet chart: Riven, Riven, Yorick.
audit.why: 53.55% over 1154 games — Riven's lead is levels 2-6 and collapses once Maiden is permanent; the chart said the opposite at both ends.
audit.corrected: Levels 4-5 -> Riven, Level 6 -> Riven, 2+ items -> Yorick, as three matched full/content pairs plus the 2+ items rating.

audit.why: Four spikes present and ordered: Lvl 2-3 W stun, Lvl 6 Blade of the Exile, 1st item, 2+ items Maiden.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two abilities are attributed to the wrong slots: wants.foe[0] calls Dark Procession '(E)' when it is W, and wants.foe[1] calls Mourning Mist '(Q)' when it is E (Q is Last Rites). mid then tells the player to 'track his E cooldown' while describing the cage, which is W. whys[2] and early both put Dark Procession's cooldown at 26 seconds; the kit says 20/18/16/14/12. whys[4], spikes[1], mid and wants.you[2] again call Wind Slash an execute, and mid calls it a 'cone'.
audit.why: The whole lane plan is 'track the cage' — pointing the player at the wrong slot and a cooldown six seconds too long means they hold back through the exact window they are told to punish.
audit.corrected: Dark Procession = W, 20/18/16/14/12s, 600 range, destructible wall. Mourning Mist = E, 12/11/10/9/8s, 700 range, armour shred, slow, marks you for the Walkers. Last Rites = Q, an auto-attack reset that heals him. Wind Slash is one ranged projectile per R.

audit.whatIsWrong: The tracked window was stated as 26 seconds in two places.
audit.why: Rank 1 is 20s and rank 5 is 12s — the real trade clock shortens badly as he levels it, which the page never said.
audit.corrected: mid now states 20s at rank 1 falling to 12s at rank 5.

audit.why: Last Rites heals him and the full-layer itemization already calls for early Executioner's Calling.

edits.after: Full Q-W-E rotation out-damages his early-rank Walkers before they stack auto procs; bait Dark Procession first, then punish its 20-second rank-1 window with everything.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 are about Dark Procession discipline. If you step into a cage with three Walkers active you will lose that trade every time — it is not a damage contest, it is a slow bleed from ghoul autos you cannot interrupt. So track his E cooldown on your mental timer: walk up, threaten, retreat if it is up; the instant it drops, Valor dash in, W-stun before he can re-cast, chain your Q through him and E back out before the Walkers catch up. At Level 6 his Eulogy of the Isles summons Maiden, which changes his threat from single skirmishes to sustained attrition — but your Blade of the Exile answers perfectly. He cannot outrun Wind Slash, and Maiden cannot block the cone. Bait the cage, dash around its edge with a direction-steered Q, and execute him at half health with a clean Wind Slash.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 are about Dark Procession discipline. If you step into a cage with three Walkers active you will lose that trade every time — it is not a damage contest, it is a slow bleed from ghoul autos you cannot interrupt. So track his W on your mental timer: 20 seconds at rank 1 but only 12 by rank 5, so walk up, threaten, retreat while it is up; the instant it drops, Valor dash in, W-stun before he can re-cast, chain your Q through him and E back out before the Walkers catch up. At Level 6 his Eulogy of the Isles summons Maiden, which changes his threat from single skirmishes to sustained attrition — but Blade of the Exile answers it. He cannot outrun Wind Slash, and Maiden cannot peel a ranged shot. Bait the cage, dash around its edge with a direction-steered Q, and finish him with your one Wind Slash.

edits.before: At Level 1 Yorick is surprisingly passive — he wants to stack Mist Walkers by last-hitting with Q, not brawl. Use that: trade Q autos and stack your Runic Blade charge off the first minion wave, but don't overcommit before your W lands. The real window opens at Level 2 when Ki Burst comes online. Yorick's Dark Procession has a long cooldown at early ranks — the moment you see it on cooldown or he burns it on a creep cage, run the full pattern: Q1-auto (Runic proc), W stun, Q2-Q3 through him, E out before his next Mourning Mist cast can leash a Walker. At Level 3 you have the full rotation; bait the cage by feinting in, let him drop it, then punish the 26-second window ruthlessly.
edits.after: At Level 1 Yorick is surprisingly passive — he wants to stack Mist Walkers by last-hitting with Last Rites, not brawl. Use that: trade Q autos and stack your Runic Blade charge off the first minion wave, but don't overcommit before your W lands. The real window opens at Level 2 when Ki Burst comes online. Dark Procession is 20 seconds at rank 1 — the moment you see it spent, or he burns it on a creep cage, run the full pattern: Q1-auto (Runic proc), W stun, Q2-Q3 through him, E out before his next Mourning Mist cast can leash a Walker. At Level 3 you have the full rotation; bait the cage by feinting in, let him drop it, then punish that window ruthlessly.

notes: Packet suspectNames flagged 'Dark Procession' twice as a probable wrong name — the name is correct, those are false positives. The real defects were the slot labels (W written as E, E written as Q) and a 26-second cooldown that does not exist at any rank. Full-layer prose carries mojibake em dashes on disk, so full-layer edits are limited to clean-ASCII enum fields.
